meta.name: Twisted 720p
meta.description: A one-hour mystery full of twists and turns that follows Danny Desai, a charismatic 16-year-old with a troubled past who returns to his hometown after spending five years in juvenile detention. Immediately branded an outcast, Danny attempts to reconnect with his two childhood best friends, Jo and Lacey. But when a fellow student is found dead in her home, Danny instantly becomes the prime suspect and town spirals into a frenzy of suspicion and mystery. Jo and Lacey must decide if their childhood friend is unforgivable, or if he's really a victim being persecuted for his own twisted secrets.

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: Danny, a charismatic sixteen-year-old with a troubled past, reconnects with his two best friends from childhood. But with his arrival, he suddenly becomes the prime suspect in a murder when a fellow student is found dead in her home.

videos.title: Grief Is a Five Letter Word
videos.overview: Danny and Karen host a dinner for Jo and her parents, but Kyle takes advantage of the situation and searches for evidence that will link Danny to Regina's murder. Meanwhile, Lacey and the other students learn to grieve for Regina.

videos.title: PSA de Resistance
videos.overview: Danny and Jo volunteer to work on a skit with Lacey and her friends to learn more about Regina's murder.

videos.title: Sleeping with the Frenemy
videos.overview: At Lacey’s sleepover, Jo discovers something that sheds light on a possible new piece of evidence for Regina’s murder.

videos.title: The Fest and the Furious
videos.overview: The residents of Green Grove are upset when Danny goes to the Annual Fall Festival which leads to an embarrassing public confrontation.

videos.title: Three for the Road
videos.overview: Danny, Jo and Lacey go on a road trip to follow a clue as to who might have sent the envelope to Regina.

videos.title: We Need to Talk About Danny
videos.overview: Jo and Lacey figure out a way to tell Danny about his father living at the apartment where Regina’s envelope full of cash came from. Meanwhile, after Rico’s confession of what he saw, Kyle is even more determined to find Tara’s necklace.

videos.title: Docu-Trauma
videos.overview: Danny throws a party and Tyler agrees to help if he can film it for a documentary, while Kyle confronts Karen about the recovered necklace that she threw into the river.

videos.title: The Truth Will Out
videos.overview: Karen sticks to her confession despite what it could mean for her and Danny’s future. Lacey's dad returns.

videos.title: Poison of Interest
videos.overview: Accusations against Danny could get him kicked out of school, and Jo is upset when a video is released.

videos.title: Out with the In-Crowd
videos.overview: Jo is still hurt over the video, and Lacey has become an outcast at school.

videos.title: Dead Men Tell Big Tales
videos.overview: Jo struggles with her conflicted feelings about Danny; Karen seeks help from an old friend.

videos.title: Sins of the Father
videos.overview: Danny and Karen struggle to overcome their past transgressions.

videos.title: Home Is Where the Hurt Is
videos.overview: Tension mounts between Danny and Lacey as the homecoming dance approaches.

videos.title: Danny Indemnity
videos.overview: Danny comes into a large sum of cash. Tess drops a bombshell on Kyle.

videos.title: The Son Also Falls
videos.overview: Jo decides to run for student body president; Lacey wants to know what Danny is hiding.

videos.title: You're a Good Man, Charlie McBride
videos.overview: Charlie's growing relationship with Jo concerns Danny; Lacey takes a liking to Whitney's wild side.

videos.title: Danny, Interrupted
videos.overview: Danny visits an old confidant; Jo questions a friend's motives; Tess receives bad news.

videos.title: A Tale of Two Confessions
videos.overview: Contradictory confessions endanger lives. Whitney's mother arrives to bring her back to the city.

meta.slogan: The truth can be a killer.
